digest.component_or_area: DC adapter test infrastructure / pagination structural guard
propositions: The pagination guard at test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py scans only transport.py, but commit 465d's module split moved all search_issues calls out of transport.py into _base.py and _issues.py, leaving the guard to scan zero call sites and pass unconditionally.
The guard's own docstring states it exists to catch unpaginated search_issues calls, but after the split it cannot detect offenders added to any non-transport module in the DC adapter directory.

The fix must widen the scan from a single hardcoded file to every *.py in adapters/jira_datacenter/ and add a non-vacuity assertion proving the guard observes at least one real search_issues call site.
An audit of tests/ found four additional single-file structural guards emptied by the same relocation mechanism, filed separately as bug 8a5e.
